scientific_integrity: Proof and reproducibility checks are provided. Priority is bounded and open to stronger historical coverage; no independent audit or certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed nonbinary alphabet order; only first Fourier interaction band. Subcritical density stays strictly inside (0,(q-1)/q); central-window thresholds stay finite; no uniform boundary rates or growing-alphabet theorem. Finite Gram decomposition is a corollary of existing shell spectra; claimed novel substance is the sharp conditioning trichotomy.
title: Three conditioning regimes for first-band Fourier sampling on nonbinary Hamming balls
